join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!filter me
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!filter me
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter me what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter me on|off


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter me on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Me filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter me on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Me filter is already enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter me off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Me filter is now disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter me off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Me filter is already disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter me on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Me filter is now enabled.


twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "f5b6adc3-e741-4661-b1e7-93372ef10098"}
handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=f5b6adc3-e741-4661-b1e7-93372ef10098 chatter-display=Random :hehe
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, "/me" is not allowed in this channel - warning


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :ok
no_send


# Ignores and other

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!ignore add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random added to ignored users.

clock_forward 3h
twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "f5ceb6c5-83ce-4dc1-8501-a37eda3d7594"}
handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=f5ceb6c5-83ce-4dc1-8501-a37eda3d7594 chatter-display=Random :what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, "/me" is not allowed in this channel - warning


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now disabled.

handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :what
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set shouldModerate off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] hortbot will no longer attempt to moderate in this channel.

handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :what
no_send
